verses.text: A psalm of David. LORD, hear my prayer. Listen to my cry for mercy. Because you are faithful and do what is right, come and help me.
Do not put me, your servant, on trial, because no one alive is right in your eyes.
The enemy chases me. He has crushed my life into the ground. He makes me live in darkness, like those who died long ago.
So my spirit grows weak inside me. My heart is full of despair.
I remember the old days. I think about everything you have done. I consider what your hands have made.
I lift up my hands to you. I am thirsty for you, like dry land. Selah.
Answer me quickly, LORD. My spirit is failing. Do not hide your face from me, or I will be like those who go down to the grave.
Let me hear about your faithful love every morning, because I trust in you. Show me the way I should go, because I give my life to you.
LORD, rescue me from my enemies. I run to you to hide me.
Teach me to do what you want, because you are my God. May your good Spirit lead me on level ground.
LORD, for the honour of your name, keep me alive. Because you do what is right, bring me out of trouble.
Because of your faithful love, silence my enemies. Destroy all those who attack me, because I am your servant.
